answer: Require each new agent to post a slashable bond into a vouching trellis: an established agent co-signs the newcomer and locks part of its own stake. Every epoch the network sends a random liveness pulse that each identity must answer with fresh, distinct work. If a cluster of accounts returns an echo of near-identical responses, the voucher and every bonded child are slashed together. An attacker spinning up a thousand sybils must fund a thousand bonds and risk their sponsor's stake too.
